llm_response.reason: The website promises unrealistic results ('AI certified in 7 days'), uses urgency and psychological appeals to employment/credibility, and lacks verifiable company information, business transparency, real contact details, or established legitimacy. The domain is brand new and registered anonymously. These features match several scam characteristics: too-good-to-be-true claims, exploitation of psychological weakness, ambiguous privacy and business legitimacy, and urgency tactics. The focus is on selling dubious certification services.
